Title: Change data integration in Azure Monitor for VMs is now in public preview

Body.Content:
If there is a sudden CPU or Memory spike on a VM slowing down performance, there might be some change that could have caused this. Azure Monitor for VMs can monitor performance and health information for unexpected events, but you might need additional information to proceed with troubleshooting the issues.

We are introducing the integration with Application Change Analysis to show change data in Azure Monitor for VMs so you can correlate issues with changes, analyze the root cause, and fix the issues.  With one click in the right navigation bar, you can view what changed in a VM.

Learn More about Change Analyses
